space: Unity prefab space, origin = footprint centre on the ground. Blender z-up/-y front -> Unity y-up/+z front: ux=-bx, uy=bz, uz=-by. OBJ export (forward NEGATIVE_Z, up Y) writes (bx, bz, -by); Unity's importer negates x, same mapping.

fill_order: Surviving primary copies retain settled order, repartitioned into122 units. Six rare forms occupy nested positions inside broad heaps. Fixed prefix render illustrates empty/reserve/full. Runtime must implement item-aware ownership and adaptive nests for sparse mixed stock.
